newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore property firm changes name.
newsitem.headline: Singapore property firm changes name.

text.p: Singapore hi-technology industrial property developer, Technology Parks Pte Ltd, has changed its name to Arcasia Land Pte Ltd, a company statement said on Tuesday.

The company, a unit of government-owned Jurong Town Corp, is the developer and owner of a string of industrial properties targetted for hi-tech industries located cross the island, including the Singapore Science Park.
Its property portfolio comprises five buildings and six industrial parks worth Singapore $2.2 billion, the statement said.
